title: Omwoyo Omugumiikiriza ogw’Ennyumba Entukuvu
intro: Mu mpapula za Quran, ekifaananyi kiva mu lunyiriri lwa nnabbi omukulu, eyaweebwa ng’ekirabo mu bukadde. Omwoyo guno gukuzibwa olw’amazima agatali gakyukakyuka n’omulimu omunene mu kuteekawo ekifo ekitukuvu ekyandifuuse ettaala y’okukkiriza. Bw’oba ​​osoma obukodyo, wuliriza n’obwegendereza eddoboozi ery’edda, kubanga lyogera mu muntu asooka.
clues: Njogerwako mu Quran wamu ne nabbi omulala ng’ekirabo ekyaweebwa omubaka omukadde.
Nnali omu ku bazzukulu babiri abaaweebwa nnabbi oyo mu myaka gye egy’oluvannyuma.
Ntenderezebwa mu Quran olw’okuba omutuufu eri ekigambo kyange.
Nasitula ekitiibwa ky’obwannabbi era ne ntumibwa ng’omubaka.
Nneegatta ku taata mu kusitula emisingi gy’Ennyumba Entukuvu.
Nzijukirwa ng’omu ku bagumiikiriza, era ennyumba entukuvu gye twazimba yafuuka ekifo abantu we badda n’obukuumi.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
